lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters is clearly visible posterior to the gill slits, with primary nodes distributed in at least four horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal carinae and circular blobs, forming a structured grid pattern across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity pixels on the superior edge to shadowed regions on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal Echeneidae (remora) individuals attached to the ventral-lateral area and pectoral fin region.
